translationRepairs: After Bohai's conquest, Xing Prefecture's Shengji captives were settled and the county founded.
Taizu pacified Bohai; captives from Xing Prefecture's Shengji County were settled here and the county founded.
Chinese 太祖平渤海 names Taizu as the agent who pacified Bohai; the idiomatic version wrongly drops that subject, and the proposed wording restores it with 盛吉縣民來居 intact.
Anduan's son Chalie died for treason; the domain was seized and the seat shortened to Chuan Prefecture.
Anduan's son Chalie was executed for great treason; the domain was confiscated and the seat abbreviated to Chuan Prefecture.
Chinese 以大逆誅 means execution for great treason, not mere death for treason, and 沒入 is confiscation; the proposal corrects those senses without adding unsupported detail.
Under Xingsheng Palace, then attached to Xingzhong.
Under Xingsheng Palace; then attached here.
Chinese 來屬 does not name Xingzhong; it only says the seat came under the jurisdiction under discussion, so inventing Xingzhong is an error and “attached here” matches the source.
箭笴 is jiàn + gǎn (arrow-shaft), not a doubled jian reading; Jiangan Mountain corrects the misread place name.
Same misreading as in the idiomatic field: 箭笴 is jiàn + gǎn, so the literal must read Jiangan Mountain, not Jianjian.
